hoy.titular: Palmeiras set to rest their starters against Flamengo to arrive fresh for the final

foto.alt: Coaching staff give instructions to two players during a training session at City Bell.

hoy.resumen: Having conceded the Brasileirão, Abel Ferreira is expected to field a second-string side against Flamengo on Saturday to protect his starters ahead of the Centenario. Estudiantes stay in City Bell until Wednesday 25th, Correa continues his recovery and CONMEBOL announced the first-ever half-time show at a final.

siete.titulo: Palmeiras to field reserves against Flamengo
siete.texto: The Brazilian press takes it as read that Abel will rest his starters on Saturday against Flamengo, who can clinch the Brasileirão. On Tuesday 24th Palmeiras visit Chapecoense at 18:00, leaving them three days before the final.

siete.titulo: Correa a doubt for the final
siete.texto: He is still being treated for a grade 2 tear in his right hamstring and there is no definitive medical update yet. The coaching staff see him as an important attacking option, but his involvement at the Centenario is not guaranteed.

siete.titulo: A half-time show at the final
siete.texto: For the first time, the Copa Libertadores final will have a half-time show, CONMEBOL announced. The artist has not been confirmed yet.

siete.titulo: The road map to the Centenario
siete.texto: On Thursday the squad trained and shared an asado in City Bell. They train there until Wednesday 25th (Sunday is a day off) and travel to Montevideo that afternoon, staying at the Hilton; on Thursday and Friday they will train at Montevideo City Torque's training ground.

siete.titulo: Without Baltasar, Medina weighs a back five
siete.texto: Baltasar Rodríguez, sent off against Flamengo at the Maracanã, will miss the final. According to El Día, the coach is considering five defenders at the Centenario to stop Palmeiras' full-backs getting forward.

siete.titulo: Around 35,000 Pincha fans head for Montevideo
siete.texto: 120 coaches are going: 60 laid on by the club, leaving the UNO on Friday afternoon, and 60 from supporters' groups and branches. Friday and Saturday ferries are sold out, and 2009 champions invited by the club will also be at the Centenario.
To promote the final, CONMEBOL released a GTA-style video featuring a duel between Guido Carrillo and Gustavo Gómez, the Palmeiras captain.

linea.texto: Palmeiras's coach has given up on the Brasileirão and puts all his energy into the final against the Pincha.
Reserves against Flamengo? What Abel said after making the Estudiantes final his priority.
Gómez vs Carrillo: CONMEBOL builds up to the final with a GTA-style video.
What Estudiantes have to end Brazil's dominance of the Libertadores.
The Libertadores final will have a half-time show for the first time.
Palmeiras will field a reserve side against Flamengo on Saturday.
Abel Ferreira after the Cruzeiro defeat: "The title has been handed over".
Palmeiras lost at the Mineirão and Flaco López played his second match in two days.
Day by day, the squad's schedule up to the final: City Bell, travel on Wednesday 25th and training in Montevideo.
Total frenzy: 120 coaches, sold-out ferries and around 35,000 Pincha fans expected in Montevideo.
Giay, Flaco López and Arias came back injury-free from the international break and are available for Palmeiras against Cruzeiro.
The squad press on with their preparations for the final in Montevideo.
Cruzeiro and Palmeiras, second in the Brasileirão, meet today at the Mineirão with Verdão badly depleted.
Abel hit out at the fixture list: Palmeiras play in Chapecó on Tuesday 24th and will have three days to prepare for the final.
